lecture: Durations in seconds; positions as a share of the film's duration (0 = start, 1 = end). Medians and quantiles cover picture shots (value 1, 2, 3, 4 or A noted by eye), excluding blacks and title cards. Start, middle, end = thirds of the duration. 'observe' = measured, with its count; 'convention' = a choice made by the skill, not measured. Details: shot-by-shot analysis of the corpus (not published).

corpus.images_regardees: about 1,900 extracted frames (contact sheets at 1, 2 and 5 frames/s) + 17 sheets per shot + 8 full-size frames of the names
